name: Juan Manuel Fangio
bio: Won five world titles with four different teams. His 46% win rate from starts remains among the highest in the sport.

name: Jim Clark
bio: Won titles in 1963 and 1965 with Lotus and was killed in a Formula 2 race in 1968.

name: Jackie Stewart
bio: Three-time champion and a leading campaigner for improved safety in motor racing.

name: Niki Lauda
bio: Returned to racing weeks after his near-fatal crash at the 1976 German Grand Prix and later won titles with Ferrari and McLaren.

name: Alain Prost
bio: Known as 'The Professor' for his smooth, calculated approach.

name: Ayrton Senna
bio: Regarded as one of the greatest qualifiers in history; killed at the 1994 San Marino Grand Prix.

name: Michael Schumacher
bio: Seven-time champion, including five consecutive titles with Ferrari from 2000 to 2004.

name: Fernando Alonso
bio: Won back-to-back titles in 2005 and 2006 and is one of the most experienced drivers in the sport's history.

name: Sebastian Vettel
bio: Won four consecutive titles with Red Bull Racing from 2010 to 2013.

name: Lewis Hamilton
bio: Seven-time champion who holds the all-time records for wins and pole positions.

name: Max Verstappen
bio: Won four consecutive titles from 2021 to 2024.

name: Lando Norris
bio: Won the 2025 World Championship with McLaren.
